summary: Vellacombe chemistry readout (13 February 1997) to Elvarmere Biosciences AB for VD-96-072: route A to the pyrrolopyridine series, where bromination of the core gives two ring-position regioisomers separated by preparative HPLC and assigned by 2D NMR, and delivery of 24 analogues for Elvarmere's first potency screen.

slides.title: Objectives
bullets: Establish a route to the EB05 pyrrolopyridine core
Deliver 24 analogues for the first potency screen

slides.title: Route A
bullets: Core built in four steps from the aminopyridine
Bromination of the core gives two regioisomers (roughly 3:2)
Desired isomer assigned by 2D NMR (long-range H-C correlations)
Isolated, not just proposed: every structure listed was made

slides.title: Regioisomer separation
bullets: Flash chromatography did not resolve the bromo regioisomers
Preparative HPLC (reverse phase) gave baseline separation
Route risk: throughput limited to about 2 g of brominated core per week
slides.notes: Elvarmere asked whether a regioselective bromination is possible - route scout B in the next phase.

slides.title: Analogues delivered (13-24)
slides.notes: Identity by 1H NMR and LC-MS; purity by HPLC UV area % at 254 nm. Isolated yields are for the final step.

slides.title: Conclusions
bullets: Route A works but separation is the bottleneck
All 24 analogues delivered in two delivery lots
Desired regioisomer secured for the potency screen

slides.title: Next analogue
bullets: Route scout B: regioselective halogenation to avoid the separation
Second analogue set once potency data are back
Dr R. Calderwood, Vellacombe Discovery Ltd
